intro: Assigned by the hermit Margoz, this task directs Horde adventurers into the cavern of Skull Rock just east of Orgrimmar. The cave has been overrun by the Burning Blade cult, who use painful demonic devices to bind themselves to dark magic. Securing these cursed artifacts allows Margoz to study the cult's presence right on the capital's doorstep.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend. The Burning Blade has infested the cave east of Orgrimmar known as Skull Rock. Inside that cave they perform vile rituals, and burn their own flesh with Searing Collars.
By wearing these collars, I believe the cultists attune themselves to demonic power. But to confirm this, I must have a collection of the collars to study.
Go to Skull Rock and gather Searing Collars from the cultists you find there. Bring them to me, and I will uncover their secrets.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you yet entered Skull Rock, friend? Do you have the Searing Collars?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good. Hiding within these collars is the secret behind the Burning Blade. And I will uncover that secret...
